source.title: An Exact Single-Rotating Near-Horizon Geometry in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity
source.source_scope: Exact local near-horizon geometry; global asymptotically-flat completion explicitly remains open in the source

theory.name: Five-dimensional vacuum Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
theory.curvature_convention: Source conventions in arXiv:2605.15005; full independent tensor replay pending

domain.coordinate_patch: r>0, 0<=theta<pi/2; pole theta->pi/2 treated by invariant/measure limits
excluded_endpoints: beta=1: Delta_minus vanishes at theta=0 and curvature diverges

action_identity.basis: Exact alpha_sym=4*alpha_NH conversion and Delta_plus/minus mapping
limitations: The complete EGB tensor has not been independently rederived from the metric

field_equations.basis: The source reports the exact geometry as an EGB solution; Symtropy has not yet independently evaluated all field-equation components
limitations: No independent full 5D Lovelock tensor replay

lorentzian_signature.basis: t-psi block determinant is negative and remaining radial/angular diagonal blocks are positive for alpha_sym>0 and 0<beta<1
limitations: The coordinate pole limit is handled by invariant limits; the global quotient is not specified

local_curvature.basis: Exact expression has Delta_plus>0 and |Delta_minus|>0; pole limit K=160/alpha_sym^2; an explicit full-angular upper bound is supplied for every fixed beta<1
limitations: Scalar curvature bound alone is not a complete frame-regularity or hyperbolicity result

axis_regularities.basis: Beta-dependent conical period Delta_phi=2*pi*(1-beta)/sqrt(beta*(1+beta)) removes the local conical defect
limitations: This local condition does not determine the psi-circle period

global_identifications.scope: global U(1)^2 identifications and bundle topology
global_identifications.basis: The psi Killing field has no local axis in this regular parameter range, so its period is not fixed by conical regularity
limitations: A global completion or explicit U(1)-bundle choice is required
A different regularization prescription would be a separate proposed physical definition, not the standard area

charge_integrability.scope: standard NHEG entropy and J_psi charge integrals
charge_integrability.basis: The source finds these integrals divergent with the horizon measure under the standard integration prescription
limitations: No alternative renormalized covariant phase-space prescription has been established

physical_characteristics.basis: No principal-symbol calculation has been performed for this background
limitations: Finite curvature does not imply hyperbolicity

strong_hyperbolicity.basis: No evolution gauge or symmetrizer has been constructed for this background
limitations: Requires gauge/constraint reduction and eigenbasis/symmetrizer bounds

mode_stability.basis: No mode calculation has been performed
limitations: Near-horizon local geometry does not determine the global mode spectrum

global_completion.basis: The source explicitly states the corresponding global black-hole existence problem remains open
limitations: No global radial solution, asymptotic matching, or branch identification

eft_validity.scope: regime of validity of the higher-curvature theory
eft_validity.basis: The source geometry is a classical EGB solution; no UV completion, omitted-operator hierarchy, or EFT cutoff is established here
limitations: Requires independent theory-specific scale and omitted-operator analysis

claim_ceiling: This vector records a source-reported local solution with independently checked geometric identities. It does not certify a global black hole, finite entropy/charges, strong hyperbolicity, stability, or EFT validity.
